Class ParquetFileReader

Namespace
ParquetNeo
Assembly
ParquetNeo.dll

Reads a Parquet file one row group and one leaf column at a time, with the definition and repetition levels of nested columns. The stream must be readable and seekable, because the metadata sits at the end of the file.

public sealed class ParquetFileReader : IDisposable, IAsyncDisposable

Examples

using var reader = new ParquetFileReader(stream);
using var column = reader.OpenRowGroup(0).OpenColumn(0);
var values = new long[1000];
BatchRead read;
while ((read = column.ReadBatch(values)).Entries > 0) { /* use values[..read.Entries] */ }

Nothing here is thread safe: readers opened from one file share its stream.

GetMatchingRowGroups(ParquetFilter)

The positions of the row groups that can hold a row that satisfies a filter, in order: the others are skipped because the statistics of their columns show that no row does. See ParquetFilter for what that means for the rows of the row groups that are kept.
